outcome.technical: THE TABLE. plugins/audit/scripts/governance/_floor_guard.py now states what the comparison sets aside as data, `SET_ASIDE`, rows of (name, function, reason): 'a label's literal text' (_literal_text_aside: a constant label, the left of a `%`, an f-string's constants; every value a label formats is compared), 'the body of a bare new test, or a new labelled check' (_new_test_aside: a new test definition is a unit only under a name the base copy mentions nowhere as an identifier, with no decorator, no default and no evaluated annotation, and not nested in a function; otherwise its head stays in the rest and the file is listed as not compared, only added), 'a docstring holding no example' (_docstring_aside: a docstring is dropped only when neither copy holds a `>>>` prompt at a line start after optional indentation), 'a reason, where the skip's own signature calls it one' (_reason_aside over the _REASONS table: unittest.skip position 0, skipIf/skipUnless position 1, skipTest position 0, pytest.mark.skip position 0, mark.skipif and mark.xfail keyword `reason` only - xfail's first positional is its condition and is compared -, pytest.skip position 0 or reason=/msg=, pytest.xfail position 0). The old _REASON_FROM/_REASON_KEYWORDS blanking (first positional of every mark) is gone. Nothing else is set aside: comments and layout are no syntax to ast. FIFTH THINGS, each kept inside a row rather than added: reasons of the skip CALLS inside a test (pytest.skip, pytest.xfail, skipTest) are row 4, its text says decorator or call; a non-bare new test stays a unit only as the rename of a gone base test with the same head and body, its head compared (row 2, pinned by fa52 and fm77); base test definitions nested in functions remain units, only NEW nested ones are held out. PART: every definition-changed finding gains a key `part` - a `+`-joined subset of callee/arguments/label/head/body, or `position`, or `gone` - and its text names the part in words (what it is called through, its condition and arguments, its label's values, its head, its body); no existing key was renamed or removed. _statement_text names a decorated def by its def line and a docstring by its first content line. DOCUMENTS: the module docstring (WHAT IS SET ASIDE, WHAT THE READING DOES NOT CLAIM), PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md's _floor_guard.py section, the plugins/audit/README.md floorGuard.mode row and a CHANGELOG Unreleased/Changed bullet state the four rows and the sentence: a comparison of structure that never evaluates code, so a new test or check can do anything when it runs and an author set on defeating it can; clean means every existing test stands where it stood, unchanged, and nothing in a test file but tests was touched.
